description:
`permanent_dataset emission-check` hashes its own executable, so it can never approve a real campaign manifest.

## Background

`crates/gf2-sim/src/bin/permanent_dataset.rs:29` documents `emission-check` as
"runs the guard that `permanent_campaign` passes before writing". It calls
`approve_emission` (`crates/gf2-sim/src/bin/permanent_dataset.rs:74`), which
resolves the running executable's digest via `running_binary_sha256()`
(`crates/gf2-sim/src/permanent_campaign/provenance.rs:220`) and compares it with
`manifest.provenance.binary_sha256`
(`crates/gf2-sim/src/permanent_campaign/provenance.rs:283-288`).

A frozen campaign manifest necessarily pins the emitting binary, which is
`permanent_campaign`, not `permanent_dataset`. The two executables cannot share a
digest, so the subcommand refuses with `BinaryDigestMismatch` for every valid
frozen manifest. Observed against the committed freeze
`permanent-zero-fraction-20260829` at revision `57c9633f`:

```text
$ target/release/permanent_dataset emission-check \
    dev/simulation_results/permanent-zero-fraction/permanent-zero-fraction-20260829
the frozen manifest names binary SHA-256 2d6edcd940abe9340143c8b724a8274fff8eca1200a491ad13deec9e386eba58,
but the running executable is 86e887504731ddc7c94e4cb69b2e6f3773ed1d9cf9eca45658e1226c1ef820b8
$ echo $?
1
```

The manifest is correct and the writer's own guard is correct:
`crates/gf2-sim/src/bin/permanent_campaign.rs:204` applies the same
`approve_emission` to its own matching digest before writing, so campaign
execution is unaffected. Only the standalone inspection subcommand and its
doc comment are wrong. The defect is that a diagnostic advertised as a pre-flight
cannot return success, which invites a reader to interpret a structurally
guaranteed refusal as a defect in the frozen manifest.

The refusal ordering is itself useful evidence and should be preserved: before the
freeze commit the guard reports `ManifestChanged`, and after it reports
`BinaryDigestMismatch`, which is what proves the on-disk manifest matches `HEAD`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `permanent_dataset emission-check` either checks the manifest's
  pinned emitter digest against the named emitter rather than against its own
  executable, or the subcommand and its doc comment state plainly that it
  verifies everything except writer identity and name the writer-side guard as
  the only complete check.
- [hard] REQ-02: A regression test covers the case of a manifest whose
  `provenance.binary_sha256` names a different executable than the one running
  the check, and asserts the chosen behaviour from REQ-01.
- [hard] REQ-03: The `permanent_dataset` module doc comment at
  `crates/gf2-sim/src/bin/permanent_dataset.rs:29` no longer claims the
  subcommand runs the guard that `permanent_campaign` passes before writing,
  unless REQ-01 makes that claim true.
- [hard] REQ-04: The manifest-versus-`HEAD` comparison keeps refusing with
  `ManifestChanged` for an uncommitted or modified manifest; this change does not
  weaken the emission guard on the writer path.

## Notes

Found during the `7a816262` freeze validation. The freeze record documents the
mismatch at
`dev/simulation_results/permanent-zero-fraction/permanent-zero-fraction-20260829/freeze.md`
§"Pre-draw and validation record". No campaign draw has occurred.
title: permanent_dataset emission-check compares its own binary digest, never the pinned emitter
